en.title: UAE Launches National Disability Policy; Global Accessibility Updates Follow
en.summary: UAE Ministry of Prevention and Community Support introduced a national policy to improve healthcare, mental health, and rehabilitation for people with disabilities, emphasizing participation in policy-making and a national disability data registry. In other news, Washington D.C.'s robotaxi legislation overlooks accessibility requirements, while the Royal Botanical Gardens received a $300k grant to enhance accessibility. Additionally, a volunteer-led Joomla CMS project secured funding to expand accessibility initiatives, and a Wichita camp adapted soccer for children with disabilities.

zh-TW.title: 阿聯酋 推出 殘障 國家 政策 全球 無障礙 更新
zh-TW.summary: 阿聯酋預防與社會支援部發布國家殘障政策，旨在改善醫療、心理健康與復健服務，並強調殘障人士參與政策制定及建立國家殘障資料庫。同時，華盛頓特區的機器人計程車法案未提及無障礙需求，皇家植物園則獲得30萬美元補助金提升無障礙設施。此外，志願者領導的Joomla CMS項目獲基金資助擴展無障礙功能，威奇托營隊調整足球讓殘障兒童參與。
